note: City of Blair RV park at 19th and Nebraska Streets, entered from Nebraska Street: paved back-in pads on a small loop beside a playground, with an area for tents. A railroad runs about 60 m south. Pay by honor-system envelope at the shower house. Season April-October per an earlier listing; the city's page doesn't say. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the city's page and rules sheet: first come only, 14-night maximum, 8 hard-surfaced sites with electric, potable water, showers and dump; $25/night RV (with or without electric), $15 tents - fees match stored. Note's '5-night max' and '$17-25' contradicted and removed. Pin on the loop. Google 4.1 (51).
